description: LOWELL, Mass. (Nov. 13, 2019) – Democrat Lori Trahan proudly announced the endorsement of IBEW Local 103 in her re-election bid for Congress in Massachusetts’ Third District. IBEW 103 represents over 10,000 workers in the Boston area, said Business Manager Lou Antonellis. “Labor unions are a family and nowhere is that family stronger than here […]
paid_for_by: Paid for by Lori Trahan for Congress
title: Representative Lori Trahan Congresswoman Lori Trahan was born and raised in a working-class family in Lowell, Massachusetts. She is the mom of two young girls and proudly represents Massachusetts' 3rd Congressional District.
